'''Hanera''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] owner of the [[Hanera's Dance Troupe]] entertainment company on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She mentioned to one of her dancers, [[Ria Deleru]], that she never saw someone with as much potential as her.
